description: This file implements a Screenshotter class for capturing screenshots of web pages or elements, including handling styles, animations, masking, and viewport calculations within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: Screenshotter
classes.description: Handles capturing screenshots of pages or elements with options for styling, masking, and viewport management.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: A simple promise-based queue to serialize screenshot tasks.

methods.name: _originalViewportSize
methods.description: Retrieves the current viewport size, either from emulation settings or by evaluating window.innerWidth/Height.

methods.name: _fullPageSize
methods.description: Calculates the full size of the page content for full-page screenshots.

methods.name: screenshotPage
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the entire page based on provided options.

methods.name: screenshotElement
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of a specific DOM element handle.

methods.name: _preparePageForScreenshot
methods.description: Prepares the page by disabling animations, hiding carets, and syncing styles before taking a screenshot.

methods.name: _restorePageAfterScreenshot
methods.description: Restores the page state after a screenshot, cleaning up styles and event listeners.

methods.name: _maskElements
methods.description: Applies masking overlays to specified elements for privacy or highlighting purposes.

methods.name: _screenshot
methods.description: Performs the actual screenshot operation, handling background, masking, and quality settings.
